content.short: Spearbit provides Web3 security auditing services.
content.description: Spearbit is a leading Web3 security services provider trusted by top protocols such as Uniswap, Optimism, Maker, and BASE. It delivers comprehensive, end-to-end security, evaluating a project's web2 architecture and overall security posture, down to rigorous smart contract code review and verification. Spearbit mobilizes top-tier security talent to safeguard the broader rollup ecosystem, helping projects reduce risk through thorough testing, threat modeling, and proactive remediation.
